checkedAlternates.risk: Caps Lock affects letter capitalization like Shift.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Caps Lock toggles a persistent lock state on/off (group-4), whereas Shift and Ctrl are held-down chorded modifiers (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Tab moves focus or indents cursor position.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Tab inserts a horizontal tab character or advances form focus as an action/control key (group-4), distinct from dedicated cursor navigation keys (group-3).
